nodes.description: Ownable.owner address; authorization root set from msg.sender in constructor.
ReentrancyGuard._guardValue lock used by nonReentrant modifier.
BaseWallet._owner; wallet owner set by initOwner/setOwner.
BaseWallet.modules mapping(address=>bool); module whitelist used by onlyFromModule.
BaseWallet.controller; supplies walletFactory() and moduleRegistry().
BaseWallet.methodToModule mapping(bytes4=>address); dispatch table for fallback.
HashStore.hashes mapping(address=>mapping(bytes32=>bool)); consumed signed-request hashes.
QuotaStore.quotas mapping(address=>Quota); rolling daily spending quota.
GuardianStore.wallets mapping(address=>Wallet); guardians, inheritor, lastActive, locked.
WhitelistStore.effectiveTimeMap mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)); whitelist effective time.
WalletFactory.blanks mapping(address=>bytes32); pre-deployed wallet blanks keyed by module hash.
ControllerImpl.priceOracle; used by QuotaStore to value tokens.
Ownable.transferOwnership(address newOwner) onlyOwner; reassigns owner.
Ownable.renounceOwnership() onlyOwner; clears owner to address(0).
BaseWallet.initOwner(address) external onlyFromFactory; one-time wallet owner initialization.
BaseWallet.init(Controller,address[]) external; sets controller and initial modules.
BaseWallet.setOwner(address) external onlyFromModule; updates wallet owner.
BaseWallet.setController(Controller) external onlyFromModule; swaps trusted controller.
BaseWallet.addModule(address) external onlyFromFactoryOrModule; registers a module.
BaseWallet.removeModule(address) external onlyFromModule; deactivates and removes module.
BaseWallet.bindMethod(bytes4,address) external onlyFromModule; binds selector to module.
BaseWallet.transact(uint8,address,uint,bytes) external onlyFromFactoryOrModule; generic call/ delegatecall/ staticcall gateway.
BaseWallet.fallback() payable; dispatches msg.data to bound module and forwards result.
BaseWallet._call private; performs call/delegatecall/staticcall on target with value.
BaseWallet._addModule internal; validates registry, records module and activates it.
HashStore.verifyAndUpdate(address,bytes32) external; consumes a signed-request hash for a wallet module.
QuotaStore.changeQuota(address,uint,uint) external onlyWalletModule; schedules new quota.
QuotaStore.checkAndAddToSpent(address,address,uint,PriceOracle) external; enforces quota and records spend.
QuotaStore.addToSpent(address,uint) external onlyWalletModule; records spend against quota.
SignatureUtil.verifySignatures; iterates sorted signers verifying each signature.
SignatureUtil.verifySignature; dispatches to ERC1271 or EOA verification based on code size.
SignatureUtil.recoverECDSASigner; parses r/s/v with malleability guard and ecrecovers.
SignatureUtil.verifyERC1271Signature; staticcalls contract signer expecting magic value.
WalletFactory.createWallet external payable; validates signed request, deploys and initializes proxy wallet.
WalletFactory.createWallet2 external payable; consumes a blank and initializes the wallet.
WalletFactory.createBlanks external; pre-deploys blank wallets for supplied salts.
WalletFactory._deploy internal; CREATE2-deploys proxy clone and calls init on it.
WalletFactory._validateRequest private view; checks owner signature over EIP712 request hash.
WalletFactory._initializeWallet private; calls initOwner and optionally registers ENS.
WalletFactory._registerENS private; delegates registration to ensManager and reverse-claims via wallet.transact.
BaseENSManager.register external onlyManager; sets forward and reverse ENS records for a wallet.
BaseENSManager.verifyApproval internal view; recovers signer over wallet/owner/label and requires manager.
MetaTxAware.msgSender internal view; returns logical sender from appended calldata or msg.sender.
MetaTxAware.txAwareHash internal view; extracts tx-aware hash from calldata tail when forwarded.
SecurityStore.setLock(address,bool) external onlyWalletModule; toggles wallet lock.
SecurityStore.touchLastActive(address) external onlyWalletModule; stamps lastActive with block.timestamp.
GuardianStore.addGuardian external onlyWalletModule; adds/updates guardian with validSince timestamp.
GuardianStore.removeGuardian external onlyWalletModule; schedules guardian removal validUntil timestamp.
AddressUtil.sendETH internal; forwards ETH with configurable gas via low-level call.
Create2.deploy internal; deploys bytecode with salt using CREATE2 opcode.
AddressUtil.fastCall internal; assembly call copying return data from target.
msg.sender; caller identity used across authorization modifiers.
block.timestamp; miner-influenceable time source used for quotas, guardians, activity.
target.call{value:value}(data) low-level call inside BaseWallet._call (mode 1).
target.delegatecall(data) inside BaseWallet._call (mode 2) executes arbitrary code in wallet context.
signer.staticcall(isValidSignature) into untrusted contract during signature verification.
ecrecover(signHash,v,r,s) used to derive the authorizing signer address.
module.call{value:msg.value}(msg.data) forwarding arbitrary calldata from fallback.
create2 opcode in Create2.deploy determining deployed address from salt and bytecode.
Low-level native ETH transfer call in AddressUtil sendETH/fastCall.
Module(_module).activate() external callback invoked after module registration.
Module(_module).deactivate() external call made inside try/catch before module deletion.
Wallet(wallet).transact(...) forwarding claimWithResolver to the ENS reverse registrar.
newOwner parameter of Ownable.transferOwnership.
_initialOwner parameter of BaseWallet.initOwner.
newOwner parameter of BaseWallet.setOwner.
_module parameter of BaseWallet.addModule.
mode parameter of BaseWallet.transact selecting call/delegatecall/staticcall.
target parameter of BaseWallet._call.
success/returnData locals of BaseWallet.transact carrying low-level call result.
wallet parameter of HashStore.verifyAndUpdate.
newQuota parameter of QuotaStore.changeQuota.
_owner parameter of WalletFactory.createWallet included in the signed request.
_signature parameter of WalletFactory.createWallet verified against owner.

edges.reason: Ownable constructor assigns owner from msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == owner.
initOwner onlyFromFactory compares msg.sender to controller.walletFactory().
setOwner onlyFromModule checks modules[msg.sender].
addModule onlyFromFactoryOrModule validates msg.sender.
transact onlyFromFactoryOrModule validates msg.sender.
fallback resolves bound module from a msg.sender-gated modules lookup.
verifyAndUpdate requires msg.sender to be a module of the wallet.
msgSender falls back to msg.sender when not invoked through the forwarder.
txAwareHash extracts a hash only when msg.sender equals metaTxForwarder.
Quota window and spent decay derive from block.timestamp.
addGuardian validates validSince against block.timestamp.
touchLastActive stamps lastActive with block.timestamp.
newOwner parameter flows into the owner assignment.
transferOwnership writes owner = newOwner.
_initialOwner parameter is assigned to _owner.
initOwner sets the wallet owner state variable.
initOwner requires controller to be already configured.
newOwner parameter flows into _owner.
setOwner writes the _owner state variable.
modules mapping determines who may call setOwner.
_module parameter is used by addModule.
addModule delegates to _addModule.
_addModule sets modules[_module] = true.
external Module.activate() invoked after module registration.
removeModule deletes modules[_module] from state.
external Module.deactivate() call occurs before the module entry is deleted.
transact delegates execution to _call.
mode parameter selects the low-level call type.
target parameter is used for the low-level calls.
target.call{value}(data) is an arbitrary external call.
delegatecall executes untrusted code in wallet storage context.
returnData from the low-level call is returned by transact.
fallback looks up the bound module by msg.sig.
fallback requires modules[module] to be true before dispatch.
module.call{value:msg.value}(msg.data) forwards arbitrary calldata.
verifyAndUpdate consumes the hash into the hashes mapping.
wallet parameter keys the hashes mapping.
changeQuota writes currentQuota/pendingQuota with uint128 downcasts.
newQuota parameter is bounded and cast to uint128.
checkAndAddToSpent accumulates spentAmount within the rolling window.
addToSpent adds amount to the stored spentAmount.
verifySignatures loops over per-signer verifySignature.
verifySignature recovers the EOA signer for authorization.
verifySignature calls an untrusted contract for ERC1271 validation.
signer.staticcall reaches untrusted contract code.
ecrecover derives the address that authorizes the request.
_validateRequest verifies the owner signature before deployment.
createWallet deploys the proxy clone.
createWallet initializes the deployed wallet.
createWallet2 validates the signed request before consuming a blank.
createWallet2 initializes the consumed blank as a wallet.
createBlanks deploys blank wallets via _deploy.
_deploy uses the Create2 library.
create2 opcode deploys bytecode at a salt-derived address.
external BaseWallet(wallet).init(controller, modules) call after CREATE2.
_validateRequest verifies owner signature through SignatureUtil.
_owner parameter is part of the EIP712 signed request.
_signature parameter must verify against the requested owner.
external initOwner call on the freshly deployed wallet.
_initializeWallet optionally registers the ENS subdomain.
external ensManager.register call controls name ownership.
Wallet.transact forwards the ENS reverse-registrar claim call.
register verifies the manager approval signature.
verifyApproval recovers the signer via ECDSA recovery.
msgSender returns msg.sender as fallback identity.
setLock writes wallets[wallet].locked.
touchLastActive updates the wallet lastActive field.
addGuardian mutates the wallet guardian list and index.
removeGuardian mutates guardian status and timestamps.
sendETH performs recipient.call{value:amount, gas:gasLimit}("").
fastCall performs an assembly call with value to the target.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner parameter of Ownable.transferOwnership is subsumed by the transferOwnership core function.
_initialOwner parameter belongs to BaseWallet.initOwner and adds no independent semantics.
newOwner parameter of BaseWallet.setOwner is fully captured by the setOwner core function.
_module parameter of BaseWallet.addModule is captured by the addModule core function.
mode parameter of BaseWallet.transact only selects behaviour inside transact.
target parameter of BaseWallet._call is captured by the _call core function and its call operations.
success/returnData locals of BaseWallet.transact are internal to transact's execution.
wallet parameter of HashStore.verifyAndUpdate is subsumed by the verifyAndUpdate core function.
newQuota parameter of QuotaStore.changeQuota is bounded and stored by changeQuota.
_owner parameter of WalletFactory.createWallet is consumed by _validateRequest signature checks.
_signature parameter of WalletFactory.createWallet is verified inside _validateRequest.
